algorithm_contract.component_eligibility: A component must emit an immutable out-of-fold PredictionBundle for the same task, endpoint, row semantics, direction, and assay-native output contract. Every component and calibrator must already pass its own exposure, license, split, and task gates.
algorithm_contract.component_roster: Freeze one selection-locked prediction artifact per admitted component family before fusion. No sealed outcome or fusion result may add, drop, or replace a component.
algorithm_contract.fitting: No fusion weight is fitted. Equal component weights are fixed a priori; task-specific component calibration occurs upstream inside development training folds.
algorithm_contract.fusion_formula: For row i with admissible observed component set A_i, output the arithmetic mean of aligned calibrated predictions: sum_{j in A_i} p_ij / |A_i|.
algorithm_contract.incomparable_outputs: Do not combine different endpoints, lineages, classes, effect directions, assay units, or row definitions. Emit a per-endpoint prediction map rather than a synthetic universal score.
algorithm_contract.single_component: Pass the one calibrated prediction through unchanged.
algorithm_contract.zero_component: Emit structurally_missing and no numeric prediction; do not use zero, global prevalence, a neighboring task, or an imputed component.
algorithm_contract.binary_and_multiclass: Average calibrated probabilities component-wise and verify the resulting probability vector is finite and sums to one within tolerance.
algorithm_contract.continuous_and_profile: Average only predictions already expressed in the exact same frozen endpoint units and coordinate order. No generic z-score, rank transform, or unit conversion is part of v1.

checkpoint_contract.effective_artifact: fusion manifest binding component PredictionBundle hashes, component calibration hashes, endpoint contracts, masks, and output hash

held_source_and_induction_contract.exposure_inheritance: The fused prediction inherits the most restrictive exposure and use terms of every contributing component and input prediction.
held_source_and_induction_contract.graph_held_source: Every component for a held-source row must have removed that source before graph, feature, model, calibration, and candidate construction. Fusion receives no source outcome, observability, eligibility, degree, or prevalence.
held_source_and_induction_contract.inductive_behavior: Fusion is available for a new row only when at least one admissible component can score it without query fitting. Fusion cannot make a transductive or unsupported component inductive.
held_source_and_induction_contract.source_specific_component: A component that consumes the evaluated source or a source-specific untrained relation is ineligible, not missing-at-random.
held_source_and_induction_contract.wholly_removed_source: Conditionally supported as retrospective cross-source prioritization when all contributing component predictions were generated under the identical removal receipt.

input_contract.component_prediction: row hash, unit hash, block hash where required, endpoint and stratum identity, calibrated prediction, uncertainty where available, eligibility mask, missingness state, source exposure, and artifact hashes
input_contract.component_terms: Record code, weight, output-use, derivative-model, and redistribution terms. Restricted outputs cannot be silently used to create an open fusion artifact.
input_contract.row_join: Exact one-to-one join on task endpoint row identity. Outer joins preserve masks; duplicate or many-to-many component rows fail.
input_contract.uncertainty: Do not treat component seeds or models as independent biological replicates. Preserve component uncertainty and use task-registered biological cluster bootstrap.

output_contract.availability_pattern: Emit ordered contributing component IDs, component count, and explicit missing states for every absent component.
output_contract.graph_output: calibrated source-agnostic candidate-gene probability for eligible rows when all inputs share that contract
output_contract.native_output: per-task and per-endpoint equal-weight fused prediction with explicit masks and provenance
output_contract.unified_output: a map of task-specific predictions and eligibility masks; never a synthetic complete patient matrix or one scalar that hides a failed endpoint

runtime_and_artifact_contract.execution: CPU deterministic sorted row join and arithmetic reduction
runtime_and_artifact_contract.numeric_rule: float64 reference accumulation in frozen component order; reject nonfinite values and out-of-contract probabilities
runtime_and_artifact_contract.output_receipt: Hash algorithm ID, ordered component roster, component predictions and calibrators, row joins, endpoint contracts, availability patterns, output values, and PredictionBundle.

safe_loading_contract.serialized_inputs: schema-validated immutable PredictionBundles and JSON manifests only

source_evidence: The project evidence-graph, unified-model, split, capability, missingness, and promotion contracts were inspected on 2026-08-22. No upstream fusion package, model, data, or weights are registered or were downloaded.

terms_audit.component_terms: Binding. The fusion cannot broaden component output-use, derivative-model, commercial, or redistribution rights.
terms_audit.redistribution: Release only manifests and permitted predictions unless every component and dataset authorizes the derived artifact.
